later_methodology_and_erratum.finding: 2006 replaces the dilatometry/vacancy formula combination with lattice-expansion polynomials; also corrects notation and the heat-capacity/expansion relation. Original 1997 Table II values are retained separately.

electronic.volume_dependence: adopted as independent of volume (nearly independent in cited calculation)

electronic.erratum_scope: Nine Au pressures at 3100-3900 K corrected; Pt values unchanged
electronic.source_calculation: Full-relativistic FP-LMTO in LSDA, Fermi-Dirac DOS integration; volume derivative of electronic free-energy increment fitted as linear in V
electronic.implementation_interpolation: linear between printed nodes; numerical implementation choice not an author-specified rule
electronic.implementation_extrapolation: forbidden outside 0-5000 K; thermal API requires positive T
